effects: Operational pause · ISR · Force protection · Naval blockade
iran: Direct attacks pause · Health Ministry: 59 killed, 666 wounded (Jun 27–Jul 24)
tldr: No new strike package for the first time in thirteen nights; Iran paused direct attacks in step, its Health Ministry raising the June 27–July 24 toll to 59 killed and 666 wounded. Vance and Gen. Caine had raised escalation and munitions-stockpile concerns with Trump on Friday, and CENTCOM disabled the M/T Lavine in the Gulf of Oman.
dossier: Saudi strikes on Hodeidah and Kamaran Island drew Houthi retaliation against Aramco's Jizan refinery (fire) and Yanbu (two ballistic missiles intercepted) — reported across July 24–26; no single Jul 24-dated account found, treat timing as approximate. Trump told Axios he was weighing a 'massive attack, bigger than ever before' while holding off.
